column1: # Advance-chain external-call manifest — the reviewed registry behind scripts/check-advance-calls.sh.
# One row per external call site in the crank's file set (scripts/lib/external_call_extract.py:
# the game facade, its storage base, the advance module and every module the advance reaches).
# CLASS is the reviewed reachability judgement; the gate keeps the registry in exact
# correspondence with source and requires every CRANK-PINNED row to name a test that drives
# the callee (the file must literally mention the callee function).
# Roots: DegenerusGame.advanceGame -> AdvanceModule.advanceGame (every internal it reaches:
# makes no external call); the keeper router mineFlip (advance self-call, _autoOpen/_openAfkingBox,
# Classes: CRANK-PINNED (bare, on the crank, pin required) · CRANK-TRY (wrapped at the site) ·
# CRANK-CAUGHT (bare at the site, but every crank path to it crosses an upstream try/catch —
# the rationale names the catching site) · CRANK-SELF (delegatecall/self-call into own module code)
# · CRANK-POLICY (documented intentional halt) · OFF-CRANK (not reachable from any root) ·
# CRANK-UNPINNED (bare crank call with no pin yet — the gate refuses it).
# Columns: CLASS  callee  function  file  mode  pin  rationale
